description.value: Fernie Alpine Resort is a four-season mountain resort in the Kootenays offering one of the largest lift-accessed mountain bike trail networks in Western Canada, with 38 trails spanning beginner-friendly machine-made flows to advanced technical singletrack with berms and wall rides. In summer, cyclists can rent bikes at the on-site rental centre, book lessons or guided hikes, and dine at several on-hill restaurants. The resort also offers lodging, a day spa, and kids' camps, making it a full-service destination for a multi-day cycling trip.
